name: Position Set Total 2
definition: Variables used to quantify the different calculations for position sets and currency position sets reports.

NumberOfTrades.name: Number Of Trades
NumberOfTrades.definition: Refers to the number of trades contained in the position set.

PositiveValue.name: Positive Value
PositiveValue.definition: Aggregations of all positive values of the derivative for all derivatives pertaining to a position set.

NegativeValue.name: Negative Value
NegativeValue.definition: Aggregations of all negative values of the derivative for all derivatives pertaining to a position set.

Notional.name: Notional
Notional.definition: Aggregations of all notional values of the derivatives pertaining to a position set.

OtherPaymentAmount.name: Other Payment Amount
OtherPaymentAmount.definition: Amount of money of any payment the reporting counterparty made or received.

OneElementPresentRule.definition: At least one element must be present.
